risks: A port that replaces an exact-row SQL assertion with a weaker HTTP existence check silently reduces proof strength (AC-140-1 exists to catch this).
A blanket find/replace of the module name could corrupt string literals that are deliberate tripwires.
Deleting a broken call site instead of porting it converts a canonical-row proof into no proof.
A generic query or test-only mutation endpoint would recreate the direct-store backdoor under a new name.
A non-idempotent import endpoint could duplicate calendar or Atelier records after an ambiguous retry.
Concurrent work already modifies the widened backend files; a broad rewrite could overwrite inherited changes.
minimum_controls: Each replacement proof maps 1:1 to the SQL predicate it replaces and is recorded in PT-140-3.
Tripwire strings that hunt forbidden technology are preserved and enumerated.
No assertion may be deleted without a recorded equivalent.
The widened APIs accept typed domain requests only and call existing SurrealDB-backed stores; no raw query text is accepted.
Caller-stable identities and existing store upsert semantics make retry behavior deterministic.
All edits to inherited-dirty files are surgical and reviewed against the target-specific pre-existing diff.

findings.detail: Flight Recorder / EventLedger reads issued by native proofs (`GET /api/flight_recorder?wsid=`, `GET /events?wsid=`, 'ledger GET', 'GET Flight Recorder') return 403 {error: HSK-403-PROTECTED-RESOURCE} = api/authority.rs constant_denial() from authorize_request (protected-resource grant layer; 2e28ff91 'MT-109 enforce protected resource grants' + MT-141 backend remediation on this branch). The native proof support (tests/backend_proof_support/mod.rs live_flight_recorder_session_token, get_json_with_session_token) presents only x-hsk-session-token and never performs the POST /authority/session local-session exchange, so every native FR read is denied. Present with the fd9060de-built backend too (pass-1 logs 025/026 show the same 403 before the env-invalid failures), i.e. not introduced by C-prime. Owner: backend authority contract (MT-109/MT-141) vs native proof support; needs an Orchestrator decision on which side adapts (credential the native fixture/clients through /authority/session, or grant FR reads to the FR session token).

Path: api/knowledge_code_nav.rs record_quiet_nav_receipt -> ParallelSwarmStateRecoveryStore::record_quiet_background_work (swarm_orchestration/state_recovery.rs) writes a kernel_event_ledger row without the SCHEMAFULL `wsids` array (storage/surreal/schema.surql:5758 DEFINE FIELD OVERWRITE wsids ... TYPE array<string>). Backend product defect. Reproduced through the fd9060de-built mt249_code_intelligence_fixture as well (seq 306), so it predates C-prime. Owner: backend lane (MT-141/MT-135/MT-109 state-recovery + ledger schema).
